content.name: Pole
entries: A Pole is 10 feet long. You can use it to touch something up to 10 feet away. If you must make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check as part of a High or {@variantrule Long Jump|SRD52}, you can use the Pole to vault, giving yourself {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check.
